messages.author: 9eada87ac9c1c9b2
messages.subject: Meta() Forest Plot Customization
parts:
Hello group,

I am attempting to improve the readability of the y-axis labels in the forest plots produced by meta(), but I am having some difficulty in doing so. When working with a large number of animals or groups, the labels get extremely small. Attempting to increase the font size with cex, either internally or with a follow-up call to axis(), doesn't seem to work, however. I can change the x-axis tick marks and labels without issue, but when I try to change the y-axis labels, I end up with random numbers pasted over the animal or group labels, instead. Is there an easy remedy to this problem?

Thanks in advance for the help!

Best,
Tyler

messages.author: 9eada87ac9c1c9b2
messages.subject: Re: Meta() Forest Plot Customization
parts:
Hello everyone,

An update: it appears that specifying numeric names() for the list provided to meta() instead of text names has solved the readability issue for me, although customizing size still proves difficult.

Best,
Tyler

Hi Tyler,

Here's where the current code to automate the label sizes are: https://github.com/ctmm-initiative/ctmm/blob/e1e62bccd4ea73bb718f088f29a1f74dcd6d175d/R/meta.chisq.R#L807
Feel free to fiddle with that. Most simply, you could just set CEX.NEW to whatever value you want. I'd prefer to have the code automate the font size correctly at some point.

Best,
Chris
